NO DOUBLE-PAY (the load-bearing invariant): the SETTLE reads combat_xp_accrued_to (hr_state_of projects it, accrual.js clamps its combat-XP window to max(fromMs, combat_xp_accrued_to)) and credits combat XP only past it; a stale watermark below accrued_to is harmless because fromMs=accrued_to floors the clamp.
